en: Sawamura-san, welcome back! You were tripping over your words a bit the first time you were on. How are you feeling this time?
A little nervous, maybe?
Ah, keeping your answers short, huh? Are you afraid you might trip over your words again?
Yes, that's right!
I can see you're a very cautious person.
On the contrary. I think it's a great quality.
Sawamura-san! This is your third time on the show now. Are you finally getting used to this?
I think so, yes.
Maybe it's time we stopped being so formal with each other.
Do you mind if I call you by your first name?
Oh, I wouldn't mind at all.
All right. In that case, I will. Are you ready for today's quiz, Sawamura-san?
Yes! But I think you forgot to call me by my first name.
Haha! So I did. I guess old habits die hard.
If you wouldn't mind, we'd now like you to take some PrintCircle photos with your fans.
Great, we'll be getting started in just a moment.
Thank you, everyone, for coming to participate in this very special Sotenbori Merchants Association event: "PrintCircle with an Idol"!
Now, let's greet our idol guest, shall we?
Hello, everyone! I'm Haruka Sawamura! Let's have some fun taking great pictures together!
Thank you, Sawamura-san! Okay, let's get the event underway!
Please follow the staff's instructions to make this a safe and fun event for everyone!

In this event, you will take three PrintCircle photos with each of three chosen fans.

Time your pose to take the best possible photo.
If you can do this at least once with each fan, the event will be a huge success!
Take the best PrintCircle photos you can, and create lasting memories for the fans!
That was pretty fun!
Thank you very much for doing this, Sawamura-san.
We just know you'll be the next top idol! You had the fans eating right out of your hand!
Oh, stop. You're giving me way too much credit.
No, it's true! As a matter of fact, I have a small request to ask of you.
Would you take a PrintCircle photo with me, too?
Hehe. Sure!
Wow! The perfect high school girl idol! I bet you're well versed in taking PrintCircle photos, huh?
Actually, I haven't used PrintCircle nearly as much as other girls my age. I wasn't quite sure what I was doing, honestly.
Are you kidding? You did such a great job, though. Those pictures you took with the fans today...
I bet they'll treasure them their whole lives!
Hehe. That certainly is a nice thought.
I apologize if this is a rude question, but haven't you ever used PrintCircle before?
Oh! Um, what makes you ask?
It's just, I was watching you during the event, and you looked, uh, pretty uncomfortable.
It kind of looked like you were fumbling through it, if I'm being honest.
Oh, well, that's not... I've used PrintCircle plenty of times! You know, with my friends! On the way home from school and things like that!
All right, then. The two of you will be facing off in a game of nine-ball pool.
Remember, our show's main appeal is its heated competitions.
So make sure to give it your all, okay?
Haruka-chan, was it? I'm Ririka Misaki. You can call me Ririka.
Hello, I'm Haruka Sawamura. It's very nice to meet you, Ririka-san.
(Ririka-san looks so poised and confident, like a model or something.)
Okay, let's get started!
The time for our showdown is here at last!
Pride is on the line for these two beautiful, young idols. It'll be a fight to the finish!
What sort of immodest, unladylike things will these two stoop to in order to win?
You'll just have to watch and find out!
Now, Haruka-chan! What would you like to say to your opponent before you begin!?
I'm ready! And I refuse to lose!
Ririka-chan! What would you like to say?
You'd better watch out, because I won't hold back!
Who will come out on top in this all-out pool brawl: Haruka Sawamura or Ririka Misaki?
Let the battle begin!
And the victor of this heated contest is...
Haruka Sawamura! For coming out on top, she wins a prize of 30,000 yen!

Join us again next time for, "Refuse to Lose"!
You won't want to miss it!
Until then, stay fierce!
Ririka Misaki! For coming out on top, she wins a prize of 30,000 yen!
Yay! I gratefully accept!
Hey, Ririka-san.
You were really great. And that's coming from me, a pretty good pool player!
Thank you. I really wasn't confident at all going in, but I didn't want to lose.
Now I see where that strength comes from. You're determined.
Oh, I don't know about that. If you had really given it your all, I would've been no match for you.
I know so!
I guess that makes me feel good. Thanks!
Hey, you know what? I had fun playing against you.
Yes. My life's so taken over by show business now, everything feels like a performance.
You know, always a fake smile on my face, trying so hard to be perfect all the time... That's why it was so refreshing to watch you play for real today, with complete abandon!
Ririka-san...
Anyways! I like you, Haruka-chan. Let's get together again sometime!
Sure, I'd like that!
You're really good. There were a few times there I was worried I might actually lose.
Oh, I don't know about that. If you had really given it your best, I wouldn't have given you any trouble at all.
Hm. You think so?
All right, then. The two of you will be facing off in a three frame bowling match.
I know no other way.
Right, we will.
You're Haruka-chan, from Dyna Chair, right? Nice to meet you!
It's nice to meet you, too. What's your name?
Ema Hiiragi. I'm fifteen!
Ema-chan. What a cute name!
Hehe. Thank you.
So, anyways... I have a small favor to ask you.
A favor?
Yeah, so, seeing as this is my first ever time bowling and all, I thought maybe you could go a little easy on me?
Your first time, huh? I'm sorry, but I'm afraid I can't do that. This show is about giving it your all. I can't be dishonest to the fans.
Tsk. Damn goody two-shoes!
Oh, nothing! You know, it's fine. You're right. We both just have to do our best.
I'm ready! Let's really give this our all!
Ema-chan! What would you like to say?
These bowling balls are really heavy! I've never lifted anything heavier than a tea cup!
Who will come out on top in this all-out bowling brawl: Haruka Sawamura or Ema Hiiragi?

Join us again next time for "Refuse to Lose"!
You won't want to miss it!
Ema Hiiragi! For coming out on top, she wins a prize of 30,000 yen!
Yes! I win!
Ema-chan!
Oh, Haruka-chan.
Good game!
You're really good at bowling, huh? You kicked me right into the gutter.
Hehe. Let's play again sometime, just for fun.
Hmph. Little miss perfect...
Huh!? Oh, nothing!
Hey, come to think of it, you battle in the form of dance too, don't you?
Aha! As do I! Challenge me to be your opponent, and taste the sting of defeat!
Until next time.
Hey, um, don't take things too seriously, okay? Let's just have fun.
Fun? Fun!? Let's see how much "fun" you have after I humiliate you on the dance floor!
We were a pretty good match, weren't we? But I guess I was better.
What!? Oh, nothing!
All right, then. The two of you will be facing off in a game of count-up darts.
Yes, we will.
Hey, you! Haruka Sawamura! Don't think that being a Princess League finalist means I'm gonna treat you like royalty!
Yeah, yeah! You heard me! I'm about to teach you some proper manners!
Wait... what?
I'm ready to play!
Himeko-chan! What would you like to say?
I'm gonna wipe the floor with you!
Who will come out on top in this all-out darts brawl: Haruka Sawamura or Himeko Sakurakoji?
Himeko Sakurakoji! For coming out on top, she wins a prize of 30,000 yen!
Yeah, I told you!
Hmph. I guess acting all high and mighty fits you just right, huh?
I'm sorry, but I don't understand. What do you mean, "high and mighty"?
Ah, just shut up!
I'm not jealous of you just because you're still on Princess League, okay!?
Oh. You were on Princess League, too?
Yeah, and I got knocked out early! You got something to say about it!?
It's just that I thought you looked familiar. That sort of makes us kindred spirits.
Huh!? Kindred spirits!?
Sure. I mean, yes, we were rivals in the competition. But really we're just kindred spirits, reaching for the same dream. Right?
Ugh, you're way too soft-hearted for your own good! But, still...
Kindred spirits, huh? I guess I like the sound of that. All right. Kindred spirits, it is!
Did it hurt when you fell off your big high horse!? Not so high and mighty now, are ya!?
Wait. Were you on Princess League, too?
All right, then. The two of you will be facing off in a sexy game of air hockey.

Hold <Action:Button_L2@Air_Hockey> to enter <Color:255,200,200,255>Staring Mode<Color:Default>. Stare at your opponent's chest to build up your Heat Gauge.
The game does not stop during this mode, so be very careful!
Good luck, Seira-san.
Good luck to you! Ooh, this is going to be so much fun! I love air hockey!
Um?
Oh, sorry! It's just that you're so darn cute!
I just love cute girls! That's the whole reason I became an idol, you know!
Hey, let's be friends, okay?
Friends? Just out of the blue? We've barely even met!
Aw, come on! Okay, how about this. If I win, you have to be my friend. Deal?
I'm going to do my best to win!
Seira-chan! What would you like to say?
Hehehe, you won't beat me!
Who will come out on top in this all-out air hockey brawl: Haruka Sawamura or Seira Anno?
Seira Anno! For coming out on top, she wins a prize of 30,000 yen!
I did it! Oh, I'm so happy!
Oh, darn. I lost. I really wanted to be your friend.
I said, I really wanted to be your friend!
Um, all right. We can be friends.
Yes! You mean it!? Oh, boy! I just know we're going to be BFFs forever!
Right... Ha ha...
You got 4,500 experience points.
I actually did it! I won!
Hey! I said, I won!
The lively area of Sotenbori, Osaka, is crowded with tourists throughout the year.
But, in the midst of all this bustle and excitement, is a quiet fishing spot.
Who has come to visit this serene repose today?
Hello. I'm Haruka Sawamura. Today, I'm going to try my hand at some river fishing, here at this beautiful Sotenbori fishing spot.
Let's see. Where should I go?
It seems Haruka-san has found a spot to fish.
I think I found just the place. Time to get started!
I have a limited amount of bait, so I need to be careful not to waste it.
Now, Haruka-san! Let's see how you did today.
I think I did pretty well!
Not bad, right?
Wow! You did it, Haruka-san!
Hehe. I wasn't sure if I'd be able to catch anything at first, but looks like I managed to do all right!
It was so relaxing to spend time in such a calm and quiet spot, too. I feel rejuvenated!
It sounds like Haruka-san had quite a nice time!
Thanks so much for inviting me here today!
Oh no. I didn't catch anything. That's a bummer.
Wow. It looks like Haruka-san didn't catch a single fish.
I'm so disappointed. I want to keep going!
There, there, Haruka-san. Don't take it too hard.
Well, I may not have managed to catch any fish today, but it was nice to spend time in such a quiet, relaxing spot.
Thank you for inviting me here today!
All right, then. We're just about to start shooting.
As I mentioned earlier, you'll be using the UFO Catcher machine to try and get prizes.
The show will provide you with 1,000 yen to use on the game. When it's gone, show's over, so use it carefully.
If you don't manage to get any prize at all, it's customary for the guest to give away a personal item instead. So think about what that will be.
Here we go, everybody! It's time to play, "Catcher Challenge"!
Today's guest is this sweet, young idol!
Hello, everyone. I'm Haruka Sawamura.
So innocent, so fresh! You haven't even had a major debut yet, have you?
No, I have not.
Well, now's your chance to win yourself some new fans, right?
Okay! Using a limited amount of money, our guest must use the UFO Catcher to grab as many prizes as she can.
Any item she manages to get will then be autographed and given away to our lucky viewers!
All right, Haruka-chan. Are you ready? Good luck!
Yes! I think that went really well!
(Phew. I'm tired, but definitely feel accomplished. That's a job well done!)
Hey, not too bad!
Very good! That was fine work, Haruka.
(Still, I think I could've done better. I have all kinds of extra tension in my body. Maybe fatigue is starting to set in.)
No, I have to do better!
That won't do, Haruka. You must remember to stay focused.
(That didn't go very well at all... I feel so exhausted all of a sudden.)
